Removing

- Thoroughly clean and degrease the contact surfaces of the new ring gear and the flywheel.

- Heat the new ring gear evenly in an oven to a temperature of 120° - 140°C.

- Fit the ring gear on the flywheel.

Leave it to cool naturally at ambient temperature.
